verdict.rationale: Amplitude AI lets users 'ask questions in plain language' and get expert-level answers across their data without SQL or dashboard config, and this is surfaced both natively and via an official MCP server bringing behavioral context into AI tools. This directly matches the story of AI-generated insights inside the product, though evidence is vendor-documentation only with no independent hands-on validation of insight quality. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the AI insights' accuracy or usefulness, and more detail on proactive suggestion generation (vs. just Q&A).
